name: compute_touch_separation_scale
evidence: Mean touch radius in the current frame divided by the initial frame.

name: compute_touch_frame_centroid
evidence: Averages both coordinates of every 56-byte touch record in the selected frame.

name: retain_only_latest_touch_frame
evidence: Copies the last 40-byte frame record and replaces the frame vector with that single record.

name: get_touch_area_logging_category
evidence: Constructs and returns the Qt logging category named rm.toucharea.

name: initialize_touch_area_drag_filter
evidence: Initializes the drag filter with a palm-area threshold of 900 square pixels and the recovered gesture defaults.

name: dispatch_touch_area_filter_property_access
evidence: Qt metacall exposes palmAreaThreshold as property zero and reads or writes filter offset 0x10.

name: reject_touch_sequence_exceeding_common_limits
evidence: Rejects invalid timing, excess contact count, or any contact whose width times height exceeds the configured palm threshold.

name: accept_touch_scale_gesture
evidence: Sets gesture state 4 and emits the scale signals.

name: update_accepted_touch_drag
evidence: Updates an accepted drag while repeating the palm-area check and rejects it when a palm appears.

name: set_scene_focal_point_and_scale
evidence: Snaps, clamps, stores, and publishes focal point plus scale.

name: compute_pixel_aligned_viewport_origin
evidence: Rounds the scaled top-left scene coordinate to device pixels and returns both coordinates.

name: build_view_to_scene_transform
evidence: Builds the affine map scene = view / scale + pixel-aligned viewport origin.

name: build_scene_to_view_transform
evidence: Builds the inverse affine map view = (scene - pixel-aligned viewport origin) * scale.

name: get_scene_renderer_logging_category
evidence: Constructs and returns the Qt logging category named rm.scene.renderer.

name: scale_scene_about_view_point
evidence: Keeps the scene point under the supplied view point fixed while scaling.

name: pan_scene_by_view_delta
evidence: Subtracts view displacement divided by scale from the focal point.

name: build_fineliner_v2_color_palette
evidence: Constructs the recovered tool color records and exact RGB values.

name: format_thickness_preset_name
evidence: Returns Thin, Medium, or Thick as a QString for the corresponding enum value.

name: begin_pen_line
evidence: Creates the active line from the first five-float pen sample.

name: append_pen_sample_to_active_line
evidence: Appends a raw pen sample and advances live line input.

name: quantize_pen_sample_to_line_point
evidence: Builds the packed 14-byte point with fixed-point width, direction, and pressure.

name: render_live_pen_line
evidence: Selects and invokes the live renderer for the active tool.

name: finish_pen_line
evidence: Emits the completed line to the scene layer.

name: cancel_pen_line
evidence: Clears temporary rendering without emitting a line.

name: render_antialiased_solid_line
evidence: Solid raster path selected by the v2 fineliner.

name: append_point_to_antialiased_ribbon
evidence: Stores the first point, then constructs and fills the variable-width ribbon segment to each subsequent point.

name: finish_antialiased_ribbon
evidence: Fills the pending symmetric end cap and resets the incremental ribbon state.

name: fill_antialiased_ribbon_join
evidence: Fills the gap between consecutive ribbon segments, tessellating curved joins when configured.

name: fill_antialiased_ribbon_start_cap
evidence: Fills the cached first-segment cap according to the configured cap style.

name: fill_clipped_quadrilateral
evidence: Splits a four-corner ribbon primitive into clipped triangles and sends them to the coverage rasterizer.

name: composite_antialiased_coverage_tiles
evidence: Composites the accumulated 32-by-32 coverage tiles into the 16-bit or 32-bit destination image.

name: rasterize_bgra_antialiased_triangle_scanlines
evidence: Interpolates half-width and signed-distance coverage coordinates across triangle scanlines, then blends BGRA pixels.

name: fill_bgra_antialiased_triangle
evidence: Virtual triangle-sink entry that forwards three positions and their coverage coordinates to the BGRA scanline rasterizer.

name: build_variable_width_segment_ribbon
evidence: Offsets segment endpoints along the unit normal by their half-widths.

name: simplify_eraser_path
evidence: Simplifies the captured path with tolerance 0.5 before scene editing.

name: apply_eraser_path_to_scene
evidence: Starts the authoritative grouped scene mutation for an eraser path.

name: group_eraser_hits_by_scene_node
evidence: Traverses a layer and groups intersecting items by scene node.

name: find_and_replace_erased_scene_items
evidence: Searches the scene and replaces each hit with its surviving sections.

name: split_line_outside_eraser_mask
evidence: Returns the line intervals outside the polygonal eraser mask.

name: rebuild_render_cache_for_edited_items
evidence: Invalidates and rebuilds render items affected by scene edits.

name: initialize_epaper_framebuffer
evidence: Creates framebuffer images, DRM buffers, waveform state, and worker threads.

name: prepare_and_queue_epaper_update
evidence: Clips the dirty rectangle, selects conversion and waveform modes, converts it in up to three parallel bands, and queues the update.

name: initialize_epaper_update_record
evidence: Initializes the 176-byte update record, including its rectangle list, defaults, identifier, and flags.

name: copy_epaper_update_record
evidence: Copies every field of the 176-byte update record and duplicates its linked rectangle list.

name: subtract_update_rectangle_from_pending_updates
evidence: Removes overlap with the new rectangle by replacing each intersecting pending rectangle with up to four non-overlapping remainder rectangles.

name: map_update_rect_to_packed_frame_coordinates
evidence: Converts logical coordinates for the two-row, four-column packed DRM layout.

name: convert_bgra_update_to_tone_levels
evidence: Dispatches BGRA conversion through the selected update-mode threshold table.

name: quantize_bgra_pixels_with_tetrahedral_thresholds
evidence: Interpolates the 33-cube thresholds and emits one of eight tone levels.

name: read_color_threshold_cube
evidence: Reads one exact-size 33 cubed by eight threshold file.

name: load_panel_waveform_tables
evidence: Loads the panel waveform file and builds runtime transition tables.

name: dispatch_waveform_frame_generation
evidence: Selects the one-through-five-frame generation specialization.

name: run_waveform_frame_generation_thread
evidence: Entry point of the real-time framegen worker.

name: pack_eight_waveform_drive_codes
evidence: Selects three-bit phases for eight pixels and packs them into one DRM word.
